scope: read-only primary-source interface inspection; no installed-package or runtime acceptance
findings: LLMModelConfig has an init_client callable; ensemble construction invokes it with the model configuration.
The required custom model methods are async generate and generate_with_context, which the adapter supplies.
run_evolution creates OpenEvolve and calls its controller; the controller evaluates the baseline and uses ProcessParallelController plus framework checkpoints.
The configured direct evaluator receives the candidate file path; it imports the supplied evaluator module rather than automatically importing candidate text.
LLM evaluation feedback defaults off and the pilot explicitly configures no evaluator models.
limitation: Actual installed provenance, successful model generation, evaluations and checkpoint retention remain separate remote evidence obligations.
